'''Yiyar Salvage Corporation''' was a salvaging company that was owned by the [[Yiyar clan]], from [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Yav Yiyar]] was one of their leaders.
